summary: Rev0538 hardens the FreeBSD host-proof import path by recomputing command-shape digests and requiring an exact six-tool proof-bundle digest set.
material_changes: Host-smoke receipt validation recomputes host-probe, media-command, and cleanup command_shape_sha256 values from canonical argv arrays.
Proof-bundle validation rejects duplicate proof-tool rows, unexpected proof-tool rows, and non-six-row tool digest sets.
Proof-bundle schema sets minItems and maxItems to six for the tool digest array.
Release-critical checkers include stale command-shape, duplicate tool-row, and unexpected tool-row tamper regressions.
Host-smoke checker JSON reads now use the shared duplicate-key rejecting loader.
open_risks: Real non-simulated FreeBSD host proof is still absent.
docs/00-index.md remains near the front-door line budget.
Canonical JSON remains restricted no-float JCS/I-JSON profile, not full arbitrary-number RFC 8785 JCS.
